content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — Section 11.1 (p0045).** The agreement's data-return mechanics in 11.2 (30-day machine-readable return, no fee-dispute hold) and 11.3 (secure deletion after confirmed return, officer certification) are strong and already meet the preferred position. But Section 11.1 sits in walk-away territory — immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — and, as the lead provision in the section, contradicts and could be read to override 11.2/11.3. With zero transition assistance, the clause fails even the 90-day fallback.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): 11.1 now provides up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates on request, and subordinates deletion to Sections 11.2 and 11.3 — resolving the internal conflict with the smallest possible edit, with 90 days offered as a fallback in the comment.
